title: How does Libra turn PRs, telemetry and Slack threads into verdicts and alerts?
audience: Engineers onboarding to the Libra product (core API, sandbox, Slack, Logs)
scope: PR sandbox replay (A), span ingest to Scout pages (B), PostHog watch (P), Slack replies (C), separate Libra Logs ingest (L).
omissions: Libra Issues, PR-maker, Libra Self, billing and dashboard page internals are left out

notes.title: One process routes everything
notes.text: libra-api mounts webhooks, /v1 OTLP, HMAC /internal callbacks, /slack and /mcp, and starts the priority scheduler in-process. PR replay runs in a Fly microVM; Slack turns run in-process (stateless responder) or on the alternate Codex worker.

notes.title: State: SQLite truth, ClickHouse spans
notes.text: SQLite on the Fly volume holds runs, jobs, candidates, incidents and ledgers. Spans go only to ClickHouse when LIBRA_USE_CLICKHOUSE=true. Candidates become signal_incidents before any page; the Check Run is the PR artifact.

notes.title: Failure and trust boundaries
notes.text: One Node process: an unbounded downstream wedges the event loop (seen as broken login), so calls carry timeouts. OTLP returns 503 without a ClickHouse ack. Sandboxes get no customer secrets. LLM failure returns unavailable; sendSlack blocks unproven claims.

views.title: Which inbound surfaces converge on libra-api?
views.scope: Dashboard, coding-agent plugin, GitHub and Slack entry points; replies are in views A and C

notes.title: Central coordinator
notes.text: Every surface hits one Hono process. Outbound results: view A (Check Run), B (Scout pages), C (thread replies).

views.title: A: How does a PR become an advisory Libra check?
views.scope: Webhook, gate audit, microVM replay, HMAC callback, Check Run

notes.title: Skipped PRs get no check
notes.text: Repo allowlist, draft, base branch and risk gates are audited in SQLite; a skipped head gets no Libra check at all.

notes.title: Read-only unless provably local
notes.text: Writes are skipped unless every DB is provably local; verdicts never block merge.

views.title: B: How do customer spans become incident candidates?
views.scope: Scheduler boot, OTLP ingest with ClickHouse ack, reducer reads, candidate persistence

notes.title: Truthful ack
notes.text: Ingest awaits the ClickHouse insert; failure returns 503/429 with Retry-After so exporters retry. Readers keep producer_origin='customer'.

views.title: B (cont.): How does Scout decide to page Slack?
views.scope: Customer AWS evidence, LLM verdict, incident claim, gated Slack post

notes.title: Page claim rolls back on failure
notes.text: A failed Slack send calls markIncidentPageDeliveryFailed, so the transition page is not consumed and can retry.

notes.title: Budget exhaustion
notes.text: No model budget: strong P1s use deterministic copy; others stay on watch. Non-infra pages need an active entity.

views.title: P: How does the PostHog watch feed Scout?
views.scope: Scheduled HogQL polling into findings and Scout candidates
edgeLabels: P1 HogQL: rage clicks, exception spikes
P2 SQL: triage job, finding, candidate

notes.title: Cursor after durable enqueue
notes.text: A detector cursor advances only after the triage job is stored; poison jobs dead-letter after five leases.

views.title: C: How is a Slack thread reply answered?
views.scope: Signed event, durable job, stateless responder or alternate Codex worker, terminal reply

notes.title: Two responders, one job
notes.text: Prod runs the in-process stateless responder; the Codex worker (C3b) leases jobs with no Slack token or DB access.

notes.title: Terminal is final
notes.text: An accepted terminal action is final; an ambiguous send settles as delivery_unknown and is never resent.

views.title: L: How does the separate Libra Logs product ingest logs?
views.scope: Customer OTLP log ingest into the isolated Logs server and its ClickHouse

notes.title: Routes mount under API_BASE
notes.text: With the flag off only /healthz answers; enabled routers mount under API_BASE (/logs/api), incl. OTLP and JSON ingest.

notes.title: Card-gated, isolated
notes.text: Ingest is refused before card verification. Logs keys and stores are separate; Logs ingest does not feed core PR review.
